item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-19 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/SLAV-01 Slavistica

This research aims to reconstruct the critical reception of Polish literature in Italy from the Unification to the outbreak of the Second World War, with a focus on the periodical press. The study will identify and analyze various forms of critical reception—such as reviews, biographical pieces, promotional articles, and commentaries—within Italian literary and cultural journals, examining how Polish authors were presented and evaluated. It will also consider the extent to which this reception may have relied on foreign critical sources. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Gathering the Landscape. Building a Corpus of Representations of Italy in Spanish Texts of the Sixteenth and Seventeenth Centuries (Univ. NAPOLI)
item.description:

Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/SPAN-01 Lingue, letterature e culture spagnola e ispano-americane

The research will focus on building SAIL’s textual corpus for its first historical phase, through a survey of Spanish texts representing the Italian landscape between the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries and spanning different textual genres (memoirs, autobiographies, correspondence, as well as pre-periodical), based on archival research in Spanish and Italian institutions. The analysis of selected case studies will also contribute to an initial mapping of the places represented, recurring motifs, and representational techniques, with a view to defining the expressive ‘code’ of landscape representation.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-02 12:00
Institution: Univ. NAPOLI, Napoli
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/HELL-01 Lingua e letteratura greca

PlatRef aims to carry out a thorough study of Plato’s strategies of poetic references and their relevance to his philosophical investigations. Extracts from poetry are found at key junctures, when new arguments or monologues are introduced. A full study of Plato’s strategies of references to poetry will open new horizons in Platonic scholarship: Plato’s multifaceted use of poetry suggest that Plato’s prose served as a vehicle to reach audiences well outside the Academy, thus questioning the educative role traditionally ascribed to poetry.

This research proposal stems from a critical observation conducted in the urban context of Palermo: the presence of numerous ruins and sites marked by the 1943 bombings is today perceived in a distorted way by the local community and by visitors. During an observation experience at the University Language Centre (CLA), it emerged that even long-term foreign residents interpret the architectural "wounds" of the historic center as signs of mere building neglect, ignoring their wartime origin. This phenomenon of historical amnesia also profoundly affects the new generations of citizens of Palermo, for whom the disconnection between physical space and the memory of the events that shaped it is…

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/COMP-01 Comparatistica e teoria della letteratura

This research project focuses on the apparent opacity of landscapes in relation to narrative. This resistance seems to be due, on the one hand, to the lack of attention that human history has always paid to the environment, and on the other, to the gaps in the available narrative forms, which are mostly oriented towards the human scale and the immediatepresent. Consequently, these have not been sufficient to capture the complexity of places where geological, ecological and historical time are layered without ever resulting in a linear narrative
